company.name: Guilded
company.shortDescription: Guilded helps gaming teams recruit, improve, and complete.
company.description:
Guilded helps online game players find a competent group. It slims things down to what gaming guilds might need. Guilded enables players or teams to build tools that can help them recruit faster and play better.

Guilded was founded in 2017 by Eli Brown and is headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

productsAndServices.description: A communication and collaboration platform designed for gaming teams to recruit members, improve teamwork, and complete objectives.
productsAndServices.name: Guilded Platform
